description:
As a Data Scientist at Meta, you will shape the future of people\-facing and business\-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Oculus). By applying your technical skills, analytical mindset, and product intuition to one of the richest data sets in the world, you will help define the experiences we build for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses around the world. You will collaborate on a wide array of product and business problems with a wide\-range of cross\-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Research, Data Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Finance and others. You will use data and analysis to identify and solve product development's biggest challenges. You will influence product strategy and investment decisions with data, be focused on impact, and collaborate with other teams. By joining Meta, you will become part of a world\-class analytics community dedicated to skill development and career growth in analytics and beyond.Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, quantify new opportunities, identify upcoming challenges, and ensure the products we build bring value to people, businesses, and Meta. You will help your partner teams prioritize what to build, set goals, and understand their product's ecosystem.Analytics: You will guide teams using data and insights. You will focus on developing hypotheses and employ a varied toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data\-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.
   

  

 Data Scientist, Product Analytics Responsibilities:
   

  

* Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches
* Apply technical expertise with quantitative analysis, experimentation, data mining, and the presentation of data to develop strategies for our products that serve billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses
* Identify and measure success of product efforts through goal setting, forecasting, and monitoring of key product metrics to understand trends
* Define, understand, and test opportunities and levers to improve the product, and drive roadmaps through your insights and recommendations
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and cross\-functional teams to inform, influence, support, and execute product strategy and investment decisions


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
* Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, a relevant technical field, or equivalent
* 2\+ years of work experience in analytics and data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python), and/or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R)
* 2\+ years of experience solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches, understanding ecosystems, user behaviors \& long\-term product trends, and leading data\-driven projects from definition to execution \[including defining metrics, experiment, design, communicating actionable insights]

 We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team.
   

  

 In this role in the Microsoft Dynamics Customer Experience Application team, you will work with business and AI leaders as well as internal business users and Partners to understand, explore and develop AI/ML solutions to solve their business needs.
   

  

 This role requires you to be onsite 3 days a week in Microsoft's offices in Redmond, WA.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.  In this role, you will be collaborate with a team of skilled applied scientists and software engineers to implement AI/ML solutions and enhance customer experience, be responsible for implementing AI features towards a wide variety of business problems within Dynamics 365 products portfolio as well as ensuring they are done to meet rigorous quality standards with the result being software that is used by individuals and businesses throughout the world.
   

  

* Focus on particular aspects of our product, developing extensive knowledge in the domain and technical framework, notably in Large Language Models (LLM), and play a role in advancing product development through ongoing awareness of industry trends and technologies.

* Assess the effectiveness of models and collaborate with product teams to design AI\-driven experiences and build AI agents.

+ OR equivalent experience.

+ Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

* 2\+ years of experience contributing to the design and implementation of model finetuning pipelines (e.g., LoRA, domain/task\-specific adaptation) for customer and product scenarios.
* 2\+ years of applying transformer architectures and reinforcement learning techniques to improve finetuned models for reasoning, search, and generation tasks.
* 2\+ years contributing to research publications (e.g., patents, libraries, or academic papers) and beginning to share work externally through conferences or industry events.

title: Data Scientist
description:
We're transforming the trillion\-dollar world of in\-person sales by capturing and analyzing a never\-before\-digitized dataset: face\-to\-face conversations. While the tech world obsesses over digital interactions, most of our economy still runs on millions of in\-person sales and service conversations happening daily across the U.S. Unlike Zoom calls, these conversations weren't historically recorded – leaving petabytes of rich data untapped. Until now.
   

  

 Companies in hundreds of industries rely on frontline salesforces working in\-person, yet they've operated with zero visibility into these critical customer interactions. Meanwhile, sales productivity follows a stark Pareto distribution – the vast majority of commissions accumulate to a small percentage of top performers, leaving millions of salespeople struggling to achieve financial freedom.
   

  

 With Siro, we're democratizing sales excellence. Our customers see their reps closing up to 40% more deals, all while gaining unprecedented insights from field conversations.
   

  

 We've built an intelligence platform that captures, processes, and derives actionable insights from in\-person sales and service conversations. Our customers span diverse industries – home improvement, home services (HVAC, plumbing), retail, B2B distribution, insurance, hospitality, and more.
   

  

 With over $75M in backing from world\-class investors, we're on a mission to make field sales the most accessible path to financial freedom.
   

  

 Our product is already making waves \- 4\.8 stars on the App Store (700\+ ratings), 5\.0 stars on G2 (25 reviews), and partnerships with industry leaders like ServiceTitan (NASDAQ: TTAN).
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a pioneering Data Scientist. This role combines classical data science with cutting\-edge LLM applications, sitting at the intersection of business intelligence, experimentation, and AI\-powered product features.
   

  

 This role will build the data foundation that empowers Siro teams to make confident decisions \-from Product launching AI\-powered features, to Sales identifying winning patterns, to Customer Success driving adoption. Your work will unlock insights that directly accelerate growth and shape our product strategy.
   

  

 If you're excited about turning raw data into actionable insights and shaping the future of a high\-growth AI\-first company, this is the role for you.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 Product Analytics and Business Intelligence
   

  

* Partner with multiple functions to understand customer behavior, visualize usage trends, and identify opportunities
* Develop and optimize product analytics infrastructure and dashboards for internal and external stakeholders
* Contribute to weekly and quarterly business reviews for strategic accounts


 Ad Hoc Insights and LLM Applications
   

  

* Explore customer sales conversation data to extract insights via LLM\-based and traditional analysis methods
* Communicate ad hoc insights to external customers
* Implement LLM evaluations


 Data Quality
   

  

* Own data quality in our databases
* Establish data quality standards and monitoring
* Identify improvements needed and work with Engineering to implement


 Success Metrics
   

  

* Adoption rate of data products, internal and customer\-facing
* Impact on product development velocity and decision quality
* Quality and reliability of AI\-powered insights
* % of product decisions backed by quantitative data


**Qualifications**
* 3\-5 years of experience in data science, ML/AI, or related field
* Strong foundation in statistics and experimental design
* Expertise in Python, SQL, and data pipeline development
* Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Metabase, Tableau)
* Experience working with structured and unstructured data
* Strong problem\-solving skills with a business\-focused approach
* Excellent communication skills
* Familiarity with LLMs


 Our Tech Stack
   

  

 Core Tools
   

  

* Data Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, Postgres
* BI/Analytics: Mixpanel, Explo
* Languages: Python, SQL
* Version Control: Git


 AI/ML Stack
   

  

* LLM Frameworks: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google LangChain
* Data Science \& ML Libraries: pandas, scikit\-learn
* NLP Tools: Hugging Face


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with Node.js/TypeScript
* Background in conversation AI or natural language processing


 Who You Are
   

  

* Product\-minded data scientist who balances rigorous analysis with practical impact
* Strong communicator who can translate complex concepts for various audiences
* Self\-directed learner excited about emerging AI technologies
* Collaborative team player who thrives in a fast\-paced environment
* Passionate about using data to improve human performance and outcomes


*At Siro, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

Senior Data Scientist (Intelligence and Insight Specialist Level two)



Location: Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Palmerston North or Tauranga


**About the role \- Mo te tunga**



You will be a thought leader in a team of experienced Intelligence and Insight Specialists, with a range of technical capabilities and subject matter expertise. You will have a cutting\-edge cloud\-based platform at your disposal, including Snowflake, SAS Viya, and Posit products. Can you combine the two, understanding the design of the 'bigger picture', building enduring data assets, insights, and analytical outputs?


**You will also:**


* work with others to develop and implement enduring and scalable data and analytics solutions
* develop and embed data, intelligence and insights standards to ensure integrity of IR's insights assets and maximise their value across the organisation
* own and lead initiatives to develop solutions that deliver the right outcomes for customers, IR and the government
* support/promote our strategic direction and explore opportunities to move forward in innovative ways
* within your area of expertise, coach and mentor others to assist capability uplift and support better customer outcomes.


**About you \- Mou**


**Alongside these core skills you will have experience in the following:**


* Relationship management with stakeholders and business partners
* Excellent written and oral communication skills to interpret and present complex information in a clear, concise and meaningful way
* Comfort and experience in engaging with people at all levels of the organisation
* A passion for driving the team/unit forward and a focus on the delivery of great outcomes


**You will also need to have significant applied experience in one or more of the following:**


* Strong programming skills in R and/or Python, with demonstrated ability to write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code. In addition, you should have experience in developing reusable code packages and libraries, implementing version control practices, and establishing reproducible analytical workflows
* Strong SQL proficiency to efficiently extract, transform and manipulate data from databases, as well as analytical skills to identify data anomalies, inconsistencies and quality issues
* Develop and deploy predictive models using supervised and unsupervised techniques, by selecting the appropriate algorithms based on business problems and data characteristics
* Display hands\-on experience managing the complete model development lifecycle, including extracting data, conducting exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model training and validation through to deployment and ongoing performance monitoring/evaluation
* Craft compelling data\-driven stories to secure stakeholder buy\-in by recommending optimal approaches based on analytical findings / predictive models, with strong storytelling and evidence\-based influence to drive decision\-making and project success


This is your opportunity to innovate and challenge yourself in a world class service organisation. We offer an agile environment and flexible work practices where you'll be encouraged to innovate and prioritise your professional development to achieve your career goals.


**About the team \- Mo te roopu**



Data, Analytics and Insights (DA\&I) brings together all the work that revolves around IR's data into one place. DA\&I manages, models and interprets the data to give IR a deeper understanding of what is important to the organisation.



Sitting within DA\&I, the Data Analytics Practice Development and Delivery (DAPDAD) team accesses a range of data and analytical tools, products and techniques to derive deeper insight into business problems, allowing the creation of bespoke solutions that fulfil business needs.



We utilise and connect IRs data with relevant external data, to create a contextual representation of customers tax relevant affairs. This representation, generated through data analytics and modelling, enables a deeper understanding of behaviour and detection of risks, supporting the wider business to apply right\-time interactions and interventions.



As an Intelligence and Insight Specialist in the DAPDAD team, you would be contributing to programmes of work using your data analytics and insights capability. This means you would need to have the skills, knowledge, and experiences to be able to work through complex technical problems and challenge the thinking to get the best outcome. This doesn't necessarily mean that Intelligence and Insight Specialists in DAPDAD need to have a high level of capability in every technical skill, however proficiency in a number of the technical skills would be a requirement.


**About us \- Mo matou**



Whaia e koe te iti Kahurangi, ki te tuohu koe, me he maunga teitei

Our models are foundational to planning, pricing, operational efficiency, and growth strategy \- supporting key investment decisions and unlocking OpenAI’s full potential.

 We’re looking for a senior Machine Learning Data Scientist to lead our forecasting initiatives.
